About Dipole Group
We are a wholly Australian owned and operated ICT and Telecom networks specialist delivery business. Dipole operates locally, regionally, and internationally. Our capabilities span across Telecommunications, Finance, Insurance, health, Public Services, Print / Digital Media, Broadcast and Supply Chain. Dipole Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The Role
We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer with strong experience to join our growing team and contribute to the development that empowers our organization to deliver exceptional customer experiences. Apply your expertise, technical acumen, and leadership skills to drive innovation and make a significant impact on our business growth.

Key Responsibilities Include:
Design and maintain Automation framework and scripts
Maintain and enhance test automation frameworks using programming languages (Java/Python/JavaScript).
Responsible for creation and implementation of test strategy, test plans, test data for testing.
Conducting and scheduling regression testing using CI/CD pipelines and documenting the results.
Reviewing requirements with Business Analysts and Technical leads
Involve with business and development teams to understand the requirements.
Review design documents for new features and participate in design reviews with the development team.
Involve in Client Engagements to understand the testing scope of the product and release
Preparing Test data by clearly analysing the requirements
Involve in Sprint Backlog refinements / grooming and planning sessions
Developing scenarios and executing automation scripts using automation framework
Implementing and maintaining regression test suite which saves the time for regression testing
Conducting demos to the stakeholders after completing the user stories
Preparation of Test Completion Report, Defect Analysis Report and share with stakeholders

Candidate Qualification:
5 years of experience in software testing as Automation and Functional tester.
Expertise in designing test scripts using Selenium Maven TestNG , Playwright, Cucumber and Rest Assured framework.
Experience in developing test plans, test cases, test data and test reports.
Experience in functional testing, User Acceptance Testing, Integration Testing, Regression Testing, UI Automation Testing using Java-selenium and Web service Automation using Cucumber and TestNG framework
Extensive experience in SDLC and Agile Process
Designing test cases and test scenarios, conducted functional, ad-hoc and exploratory testing for the variety of applications with expanded test coverage
Experience in working with GitHub as source code management tools
Experience in Bug tracking Tools like JIRA
Effective time management skills – prioritization of tasks and own time by regular follow- up meetings
Ability to remain highly focused and self-motivated in a fast-paced, demand environment.
Critical thinking and analytical skills
Good communication and teamwork skills

Next Steps
If you would like to express interest in the role, please click on the APPLY button now. Due to the high number of applicants, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussion within 3-5 business days. We thank you for taking an interest in this opportunity with us.

result.description:
Title: OutSystems Developer / Consultant
Company: KRE8 IT Pty Ltd
Location: Narre Warren / Melbourne based preferred, with the option to work remotely within Australia. Applicants must be based in Australia due to the regulatory requirements of some of our clients.
Salary: $110,000 - $140,000 per annum, depending on relevant experience
Employment type: Full-time

About KRE8 IT
KRE8 IT is a Melbourne-based technology consulting company specialising in practical software delivery, low-code development, systems integration, and digital transformation. We work with clients to design, build, and support business-critical applications, with a strong focus on governed delivery, maintainable architecture, and high-quality outcomes.
We are seeking an OutSystems Developer / Consultant to support the design, development, implementation, and ongoing improvement of OutSystems applications for our clients.

About the role
The OutSystems Developer / Consultant will work across the full delivery lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, application development, integration, testing, deployment support, and continuous improvement. The role requires strong hands-on OutSystems development capability as well as the ability to work in a consulting environment with clients and internal delivery teams.

Key responsibilities
*   Design, develop, test, and maintain applications using OutSystems.
*   Work with both OutSystems O11 and OutSystems Developer Cloud environments.
*   Translate business requirements into reliable, maintainable application solutions.
*   Develop integrations with external systems, APIs, data services, and business platforms.
*   Support implementation of complex business workflows, decision logic, and rules-driven functionality.
*   Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, designers, analysts, and other developers to deliver fit-for-purpose solutions.
*   Contribute to application architecture, technical design, estimation, documentation, and delivery planning.
*   Troubleshoot, optimise, and improve existing OutSystems applications.
*   Support quality assurance, deployment activities, and production support where required.
*   Apply secure, scalable, and maintainable development practices.

Required experience, qualifications, and skills
*   Minimum 1 year of experience developing applications with OutSystems, including both O11 and ODC.
*   A Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field is required. Where the qualification is not directly relevant to the position, the applicant must demonstrate a minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience.
*   Must be based in Australia and able to work with clients operating under Australian regulatory requirements.
*   Strong software development experience, including application design, data modelling, integration, testing, and debugging.
*   Experience working in consulting, client delivery, or project-based software delivery environments.
*   Ability to analyse business requirements and convert them into practical technical solutions.
*   Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
*   Ability to work independently and manage delivery responsibilities with attention to quality and detail.

Highly regarded
*   Demonstrated experience implementing complex decision logic using business rules management systems.
*   Experience implementing applications in the healthcare industry.
*   Working understanding of the FHIR interoperability standard.
*   Experience with API integration, workflow automation, data exchange, and enterprise application integration.
*   Relevant OutSystems certifications.

How to apply
Please apply through this job advertisement platform with your resume and a short cover note outlining your relevant OutSystems experience, including your experience with O11 and ODC.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     St John of God Health Care (SJGHC) is one of the largest private providers of health care services in Australia, employing more than 16,000 employees (caregivers). We operate 26 hospitals and services comprising more than 3,300 hospital beds, including home nursing, disability services and social outreach programs.

This is a unique opportunity for an exceptional and visionary General Manager, Data & AI to establish and lead our AI and Data Analytics Centre of Excellence (ACoE) and drive the next phase of our data and digital transformation journey.

Reporting to the Chief Technology & Corporate Services Officer, this pivotal role will shape how data, analytics and artificial intelligence are leveraged across the organisation to improve clinical outcomes, enhance operational performance and support strategic decision-making. You will champion a data-driven culture, helping leaders across our hospitals and services unlock the value of information to deliver better outcomes for patients, employees (caregivers) and the organisation.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the growth of SJGHC's AI and Data Analytics Centre of Excellence (ACoE), driving a culture of innovation and data-informed decision making.

Develop and execute the enterprise AI, data and analytics strategy to support organisational performance, clinical excellence and strategic priorities.

Lead the use of data, analytics and artificial intelligence to deliver actionable insights, improve outcomes and create business value across the organisation.

Provide leadership and oversight of enterprise data governance, information management, reporting and analytics frameworks.

Build and lead a high-performing multidisciplinary team across data, analytics and AI functions.

Partner with executive, clinical and operational leaders to advance digital innovation, interoperability and evidence-based decision making.

Drive the development of modern data platforms and analytical capabilities that support precision medicine, population health and operational excellence.

Identify and leverage emerging technologies, data sources and AI opportunities to deliver transformational outcomes for patients, caregivers and the organisation.

To be successful, you will be a strategic and influential leader with significant experience leading enterprise data, analytics, business intelligence or AI functions within a large and complex environment. You will combine strong technical expertise with exceptional stakeholder engagement, change leadership and people management skills.

Experience driving organisational transformation, establishing governance frameworks and translating complex data into meaningful business outcomes will be essential. Exposure to healthcare, highly regulated industries or complex service environments will be highly regarded.

This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of AI and analytics within a values-based healthcare organisation that is committed to innovation and excellence.

Above all, people will be at the core of everything you do committing to and supporting our Mission and Values.

We can offer you

Competitive remuneration and benefits

Permanent Full-Time position

Based in Perth or Melbourne

Salary packaging up to $18,550 on a range of benefits such as mortgage, rent, meal entertainment, holiday accommodation or other everyday living expenses as well as options to salary package benefits above the FBT cap on items such as:

Novated leasing 

work related expenses

self-education and

additional superannuation

A healthy work-life balance through flexible work options, additional purchased leave and well-being programs

Employee discount on St John of God Hospital & Medical Services and Private Health Insurance

Employee support through our dedicated free Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Access to a range of Lifestyle, Health & Wellbeing rewards and discounts

result.description: DGR Global Limited  Reporting to the Technical Services Manager, this position is responsible for managing, analysing and interpreting geological data to support mineral exploration programs, resource estimation, mine planning and technical reporting.      Benefits   Task & responsibilities   Build, maintain and manage geological databases, including drillhole, geochemical, survey and tenement data.  Validate, audit and interpret geological, drilling, sampling and assay data to ensure data integrity and support exploration and resource estimation.  Integrate geological, geochemical, geophysical and satellite datasets to develop geological interpretations and three-dimensional models.  Support exploration programs, resource estimation, mine planning and feasibility studies through geological analysis and technical advice.  Prepare geological maps, technical reports and statutory reporting documentation for internal and external stakeholders.  Collaborate with geologists, resource geologists and technical teams to improve geological data governance, modelling and exploration workflows.    Qualification & experience   Degree in Geology or a closely related discipline.  Minimum 7 years' experience in mineral exploration, resource geology or geoscientific data management.  Experience working with porphyry or porphyry-related mineral systems across the exploration and development lifecycle.  Proficiency with AcQuire, Leapfrog Geo, Leapfrog Edge, ArcGIS and/or QGIS.  Strong understanding of geological data governance, QA/QC and resource modelling.  Excellent analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills.   About Company     DGR Global Ltd is an Australian mineral exploration and project development company with operations supporting exploration and resource development projects in Australia and internationally. We are seeking an experienced Geoscience Data Specialist (GDS) to join our Technical Services team based in Brisbane.
